input.quote: (g) Revisions. During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall make available to Licensee any Revisions of the Software or Documentation at no extra charge, subject to limitations explicitly set forth in this Agreement. The Licensor will make such available to the Licensee when the Licensor makes such Revisions generally available to its other licensees.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on us. Searches for MFN / "no less favo(u)rable" / best-price / other-customer language return nothing, and the commercial provisions (per-trade fee bands at sec-p0059 to sec-p0063, time of payment, the rebate shares at p0076 and the Supplemental Payments revenue share at p0078) are fixed terms with no requirement that we extend the Licensor terms given to any third party or match third-party offers. The only "other licensees" reference (p0094) runs in our favour, requiring the Licensor to release Revisions to us when it makes them generally available to its other licensees. The single third-party-matching mechanic is the Article XXII Right of First Refusal (p0139), which applies to a sale of substantially all our assets or a merger; that is a change-of-control/assignment issue rather than an MFN on commercial or pricing terms, so it is not double-flagged here. This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
